settings.title: Settings
settings.providerHintOpenAI: Best default path for chat + Whisper STT. Requires a valid API key.
settings.providerHintOllama: Great for local chat models. API key is optional, but Whisper STT is currently unavailable on this path.
settings.providerHintCustom: Use this for OpenAI-compatible gateways. Chat should work, while speech features depend on your provider.
settings.profileHint: Profiles save provider, endpoint, model, and a separate OS Keychain entry for the API key.
settings.profileNameDuplicate: A profile with this name already exists.
settings.profileCreateKeyRequired: Enter an API key before saving a new OpenAI profile. Existing keys are not copied between profiles.
settings.profileSwitchUnsaved: Switch profiles and discard unsaved settings?
settings.profileDeleteConfirm: Delete config profile "{name}"? Its saved API key entry will also be removed.
settings.apiBaseUrlInvalid: API Base URL must start with http:// or https://.
settings.apiKeyHint: Your API key is stored securely in the OS Keychain
settings.apiKeyOptionalHint: Optional for Ollama and compatible local gateways. Leave empty if your endpoint does not require authentication.
settings.apiKeyKeep: Leave empty to keep current key
settings.sttUnavailableOllama: Voice input is disabled for Ollama because the current integration only verifies chat-compatible endpoints, not Whisper transcription.
settings.ttsVoiceHint: Applies to all AI speech synthesis. Requires internet connection.
settings.ttsPreviewTextEn: This is a quick voice preview for SpeakMate.
settings.ttsPreviewTextZh: 这是 SpeakMate 的语音试听。
settings.diagnosticsHint: Run a lightweight check for chat, microphone transcription readiness, and Edge TTS availability.
settings.diagnosticsPrivacyHint: Copied diagnostics include profile, base URL, model, and API-key saved status only. They never include the API key value.
settings.saveBeforeDiagnostics: Save the current settings before running diagnostics.
settings.diagnosticsEmpty: No diagnostics yet. Save your settings, then run a check here.
